entry.title: Independent verification: a fault in our own checking, not in the service
entry.content: Our check timed out and called the database unreachable. Other checks read it in the same run, so it was not. A read that does not finish now reads as slow rather than as an outage. We recorded Independent verification changing from operational to a major outage at 2026-09-06T05:54:17.523Z, and that reading was our own, so the entry is kept and corrected rather than deleted.

entry.title: Company control plane: a fault in our own checking, not in the service
entry.content: Our check was wrong, not the app. The app improved how it turns signed-out visitors away, and the check was still looking for the old behaviour. Fixed the same day. We recorded Company control plane changing from operational to a partial outage at 2026-08-21T18:53:23.574Z, and that reading was our own, so the entry is kept and corrected rather than deleted.
